Adjustment process (line 1): underreported tax (pay with the 941-X), or overreported tax applied as a credit to the Form 941 for the period in which the 941-X is filed; required when correcting both under- and over-reported amounts. Claim process (line 2): overreported tax only, refund or abatement. Overreported corrections in the last 90 days of the period of limitations must use the claim process (and a separate 941-X for any underreported amounts). One 941-X per quarter corrected.

Underreported: file by the due date of the return for the period in which the error was discovered and pay by filing (interest-free). Period of limitations: overreported - 3 years from the date Form 941 was filed or 2 years from payment, whichever later; underreported - 3 years from filing; Forms 941 for a year are deemed filed on April 15 of the following year.
